hyps.why: With edge 3 absent, edge 5 is a main route to the output so removing it is very costly.
Filling an empty direct edge with a conv adds a new high-capacity route.
Edge 2 is already dead when edge 0 is none so removing it costs nothing.
Edge 2 is already cut from the output when edge 5 is none so removing it is free.
Edge 1 is dead when edge 5 is none so removing it costs nothing.
Edge 4 is dead when node 1 has no input so removing it is free.
Edge 4 is dead when node 1 has no input so the upgrade gains nothing.
With edge 5 none, node 2 cannot reach the output so edge 1 is dead and upgrading it does nothing.
If edge 5 is none, edge 2 cannot reach the output so upgrading it is wasted.
Replacing the direct skip with a 3x3 conv gains less than filling an empty edge.
